bioconda.name: readfaker
bioconda.summary: Simulate Oxford Nanopore reads with realistic length and quality profiles learned from real data.
bioconda.description:
ReadFaker simulates Oxford Nanopore reads by extracting empirical read length and quality models from real sequencing data in FASTQ or BAM format.
Errors are introduced from these quality scores, and the error model can be customized to adjust parameters such as substitution and indel rates.
